notes: Both files were captured from the live GDACS services. rss.xml is https://www.gdacs.org/xml/rss.xml trimmed from 287 to 69 items (all 7 earthquakes, 3 cyclones, 16 floods and 9 droughts; every eighth current and every sixth non-current forest fire); the 'Records number' comment was adjusted and the UTF-8 byte-order mark dropped, items are otherwise unmodified. search.json is the untrimmed response of the event-list API for eventlist=TC;FL;VO;DR, fromDate=2026-10-27, toDate=2026-11-10 (50 events, 28 of which are also in the RSS feed). The malformed variants were authored by hand from the same schemas.
